notFound.title: That page is not here
notFound.description: The address exists in nobody's sitemap. It may have been a typo, or a room that has since closed.

crash.title: Something broke on our side
crash.description: Not your doing, and not the article's. The round you were in is held on the server, so trying again usually picks it back up.

refusals.room_not_found: That room is not open. The code may be wrong, or everybody may have left it.
refusals.invalid_name: That nickname will not do — it is empty, too long, or holds characters the room refuses.
refusals.name_taken: Somebody in this room is already called that. Pick another and come back in.
refusals.bad_json: Your browser and the server did not understand each other. Nothing was lost.
refusals.not_host: Only the player who opened the room can do that.
refusals.hints_blocked: Somebody has locked your hints for the moment.
refusals.no_theme_submitted: Nobody has proposed a subject yet.
refusals.topic_not_found: Wikipedia has no article for that. Try another subject.
refusals.generation_failed: The round could not be built. Nothing you did — try again in a moment.
refusals.session_not_found: That round is over, or it was never here.
refusals.hint_not_found: There is no hint under that number.
refusals.room_capacity_reached: There is no room left on the server right now. Try again shortly.
refusals.invalid_target: That is not somebody this item can be used on.
refusals.out_of_phase: That cannot be done at this point in the round.
refusals.item_not_held: You have not got that item — it was spent, or it was never yours.
refusals.pseudonym_taken: Another account already has that pseudonym, and keeps it. Choose a different one.
refusals.quest_not_found: That quest is not one of yours.
refusals.quest_already_claimed: You have already taken that reward.
refusals.quest_not_complete: That quest is not finished yet. Play a little more and it will be.
refusals.insufficient_coins: You have not got enough coins for that.
refusals.coins_not_accepted: Hints are not bought with coins in a room — a ranked round is played, not paid for.
refusals.cosmetic_not_owned: That is not yours to wear.
refusals.cosmetic_not_found: The shop has nothing by that name.
refusals.unknown: The server refused that, and said something this version does not know how to explain.
